notes.subject: to Yahwe
notes.rationale: The psalmist turns to address Yahwe directly, breaking off from the oracle quotation.

notes.subject: man bilong yu ol i kapsaitim oil long en
notes.rationale: משיחך is 'your anointed one'; rendered by the literal picture (oil poured on) rather than a title, per the glossary.

translation: Tasol yu, yu rausim na yu birukim, yu bel i hat wantaim ⟨את⟩ man bilong yu ol i kapsaitim oil long en.
